description: Trim low-quality read ends with the BWA/cutadapt running-sum algorithm (cutadapt quality_trim_index), with optional separate 5'/3' cutoffs and Phred+33/Phred+64 decoding, dropping reads shorter than minLength after trimming.

reads.description: Reads, each an object with sequence and a quality string of equal length (Phred+phredOffset ASCII).

minQuality.description: Quality cutoff subtracted from each Phred score at both ends (values < 1 disable trimming).

minLength.description: Minimum length after trimming for a read to be kept.

cutoffFront.description: Optional 5' cutoff overriding minQuality for the 5' end (< 1 leaves the 5' end untrimmed; cutadapt -q 5',3').

cutoffBack.description: Optional 3' cutoff overriding minQuality for the 3' end (< 1 leaves the 3' end untrimmed).

phredOffset.description: ASCII offset of the quality encoding: 33 (Sanger/Illumina 1.8+) or 64 (Illumina 1.3-1.7), as cutadapt --quality-base.

trimmed.description: Surviving trimmed sequences, in input order.

errors.message: sequence and quality must be the same length
quality character outside [phredOffset, '~'] or phredOffset outside [33, 126]
